data.title: HELL GRIND
data.description: ROKO, JAXX, LULU and REIN — four street kids with nothing to lose. One night, one museum, one plan — until it all falls apart when, right in the exhibition hall, they find an artifact with no name and no history. One touch — and each receives a power they never asked for, awakening something that was never meant to wake. Now they must face the ancient evil head-on — even if the road leads straight to hell. Four children the world wrote off at birth are now its last line of defense.

items.title: Anerneq
items.description: An Arctic drama about love, sacrifice and the cost of letting go.
items.shortDescription: An Arctic drama about love, sacrifice and the cost of letting go.
items.fullDescription: An Arctic drama about love, sacrifice and the cost of letting go. Exiled with her father, whose fading mind mistakes her for his dead wife, a young huntress leads him across the frozen wilderness of 1920s Chukotka to the sacred Whale Bone Alley. She believes her own life is the price of saving him—but the journey demands a sacrifice she never imagined.

items.title: If you stop loving me, I'll die — I don't like dying, but for our love I'm ready to go that far
items.description: If You Stop Loving Me I'll Die...: A deadpan silent animated comedy about love, blackmail and, above all, death. Tolik has exactly one talent: dying. Any refusal, however small, kills him on the spot — and he revives the moment he gets his way. His wife has been resurrecting him for years, until one morning she packs a suitcase and walks out. Now it's just him, a dripping tap nobody's going to fix, and a neighbour knocking at the door.

items.fullDescription: A pitch-black Hong Kong neo-noir about romance, betrayal and, above all, self-defense. A woman is home alone, still deciding whether her new boyfriend is worth keeping, when a burglar breaks into her flat after midnight: the "burglar" turns out to be the boyfriend, Li, letting himself in with a surprise bouquet - the reddest flag of all. What Li doesn't know is that she's a quiet martial-arts champion... and she's just made up her mind.

items.title: MORK
items.description: A boy loses his mother, his hands, and everything he knew in a single night — when Viking raiders burn his village to ash. Fifteen years later, he returns with iron blades where his hands used to be. He cuts through an army to reach the warlord who destroyed his world. But when the final blade is raised — he discovers that his true enemy was never the man on the throne.

items.title: SPIT & GLOW
items.description: A young woman possesses a biological anomaly: her DNA can reverse aging. When a wealthy visionary turns this miracle into a global brand, "Elixir" becomes the world’s most coveted obsession. As she ascends to global superstardom, the line between celebrity and commodity begins to blur. But as the world feasts on her vitality, she must face a terrifying reality: to keep humanity young, she may have to give until there is nothing left.

The team hits in perfect sync: a cyborg-armed breacher, a cold-blooded sniper, a drone pilot dropping flash charges, and a wingsuit infiltrator riding the chaos. Surgical, high-stakes, and relentless - every move is planned, timed, and executed like a clockwork strike.

But in a world this fast, can the legend survive?

items.title: AFTER GLOW
items.description: A breakout indie band is one night away from everything they ever wanted — until old tensions, secret hookups, and buried betrayals explode backstage. As the afterparty spirals into a night of temptation, confrontation, and impossible choices, the five friends who built the band together are forced to face how far they’ll go for fame. By morning, the music may still be alive, but the people behind it might never be the same.

items.description: A young woman starts receiving voice messages from herself — only they’re coming from the future. Each warning arrives just in time to stop a tragedy, pulling her deeper into a terrifying chain of events that seems to know every move she hasn’t made yet. But as the messages grow more desperate and the timeline begins to fracture, she realizes the future isn’t trying to protect her — it’s trying to stop her from becoming something far worse.

items.title: Da Groove
items.description: Four friends from the same neighborhood are convinced one track could change their lives forever. When their raw new sound starts blowing up, ambition, loyalty, and street pressure collide, turning a shot at success into a dangerous fight to hold onto who they are. Over the course of one unforgettable night, the crew must navigate jealousy, violence, and the cost of making it out — before the dream that brought them together tears them apart.

items.title: GOLDEN HOUR
items.description: Every evening, for one brief and mysterious moment, a hidden space is flooded with a golden light that reveals what people want most — and what they fear most. Strangers step into it searching for answers, forgiveness, or one last chance to face the past, only to find themselves changed in ways they never expected. When a grieving soul enters desperate for peace, that single hour becomes a haunting test of love, loss, and whether some truths are too powerful to survive.

items.title: LOST IN SHIBUYA
items.description: After missing the last train home, a young woman disappears into the restless neon maze of Shibuya, where every street corner seems to pull her deeper into a mystery only she can solve. As one sleepless night unfolds, she follows a trail of strangers, memories, and half-hidden clues that seem connected to someone she lost — or maybe to the person she used to be. By dawn, she will have to decide whether she’s searching for a missing soul, or for the version of herself the city never gave back.

items.title: LOVE YOU, SINCERELY
items.description: A lonely young woman begins receiving handwritten letters from someone who seems to understand her better than anyone ever has. What starts as a romantic mystery soon becomes an emotional journey through missed chances, old wounds, and a love story that feels strangely unfinished. As she follows the letters across rain-soaked streets and fleeting encounters, she uncovers a truth that could change everything she believes about fate, memory, and the person who was always meant to find her.

items.title: THE LOUD VOID
items.description: A long-abandoned space colony, once celebrated as humanity’s greatest achievement, has been silent for years. When a lone survivor returns to uncover what happened, he finds empty corridors, failing systems, and a presence that seems to live inside the silence itself. As the station begins to distort his memories and prey on his mind, he’s pulled into a terrifying fight to escape a place where the quiet is not just haunting — it’s alive.
